race.comment: OUT OF TURN (2) ended his last season on a winning note here, scoring easily off the front despite starting from a wide gate. He is fresh up without a public trial, but he slots into the pole, and has the scope to continue to make his way through the grades this year. DEVIL DEVIL (6) resumes from a spell for a new trainer after his form fell away further north. He comes to hand quickly, and should be respected if the money comes for him. HEART AND SPIRIT (7) was well beaten in a tougher field at Eagle Farm nearly 3 weeks ago when following on from a game effort for second off the top here when resuming from a spell. He benefits from a 2kg claim, and is set to bounce straight back into the money. WONDEREACH (1) cops a big weight with a drop in class here, but a 2kg will help offset that, and he is well worth including in all top 3 combos in a small field.
